claim_scope: Dedicated SAMK availability test: pre-upload dropout removes non-uploaders from the protected aggregate and re-forms the closed session without tier downgrade; a post-upload delayed uploader may recover the already-formed package later. This is a reference-workflow robustness test, not an SLA.
mechanism: T4: SAMK multi-key BFV + Paillier helper aggregation with independent client recovery
measurement_notes: Absolute energy and carbon are not reported because direct hardware energy instrumentation is disabled.
